items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: Charlie. We can move this. Go, go, go there and get that picture hanging up over there.

ctx.x: Maybe if we stopped and got the picture, we could refresh your memory a little bit that way, would that help? There's a picture, hand in some place, do you know where it is?
Charlie. We can move this. Go, go, go there and get that picture hanging up over there. Tony, that's not the old Tony tried. What year? Oh, I don't know, this was a year. The hair that colored there.
